notes.title: Version: v1.1.1
notes.notes: [p]Update Content:[/p][p]1. Fixed an issue where there was a very small chance of the game freezing during story playback[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where some text remained untranslated in the English version[/p]

notes.title: v1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Here are the update details:

1. Increased Collection Robot quantity with new limit of 40 units.
2. Increased Production Robot quantity with new limit of 70 units.
3. Increased gathering capacity from 10 to 15 Collection Robot per mineral type.
4. Added toggle option for machine production visual effects.
5. Added Honor and Overflow Factor exchange functionality at the Shrine.
6. Added Overflow Accelerator management system to control individual machine type speeds.
7. Standardized daily refresh rates across all shop items.
8. Added bathing time display.
9. Adjusted Chamber Quest upgrade experience requirements.
10. Adjusted Chamber Quest rewards.
11. Adjusted selling prices for items crafted by Commodity Fabricator.
12. Fixed incorrect description for 4-slot Transfer Box.
13. Fixed an issue when placing more than 999 items in Storage Boxes.
14. Fixed an issue where Aluminium ingot limit couldn’t exceed 999.
15. Improved Gathering machanics: low-tier seed drops now replaced with unlocked seed varieties.
16. Accelerated food preparation speed at Manual Cooking Stove.
17. Improved fishing mechanics and values.

Your are welcomed to join our Discord (2pgames.net/discord) and leave your feedback on Sim-n-Management channel.

notes.title: V1.0.9 Update -Fishing Enhancements, Trading Posts &Performance Improvements!
notes.notes:
Here are the update details:

1. Enhanced fishing system.
2. Streamlined furniture controls to match building interface.
3. Added player statistics display in settings menu.
4. Added 9-slot Transit Box to Technology Tree.
5. Added Trading Post to Technology Tree.
6. Added middle mouse wheel zooming in farm areas.
7. Added "deposit similar items" function to boxes.
8. Automatic Cooking Stove will now fetch materials from house boxes automatically (one stack at a time).
9. Added resource calculator displaying consumption and production rates based on existing machines.
10. Added plant maturity timers when hovering with cursor.
11. Increased item stack limit from 999 to 9999.
12. Fixed an issue where dungeon portals weren't disappearing properly.
13. Fixed an issue where Teleport Stones couldn't be used after boss defeats.
14. Improved stamina recovery mechanics.
15. Adjusted market values for various fruits.

Your are welcomed to join our Discord (2pgames.net/discord) and leave your feedback on Sim-n-Management channel.

notes.title: Small Update V1.0.8 - Supports 2K and optimize robot efficiency
notes.notes:
1. Now supports hotkey customization.
2. Now supports 2k resolution.
3. Optimized the management center, change the upper limit to 20, and remove the management function.
4. Optimized the efficiency of production robots.
5. Optimized the priority of watering and sowing of planting robots.
6. Optimized the medical cabin reward.
7. Optimized the power of steam generators.
8. Added a one-key transfer button when the backpack interacts with the storage box.
9. Added a search function in the transfer box and the inventory box.
10. Moveed the town's teleport point next to the tavern.
11. After all the land purchases are completed, added a seed research task to Carl, and increase the number of seeds refreshed every day after completion.
Portal stone that allows you to teleport at any place on the main map can now be acquired with the AI in the UFO
13. Optimized the store transaction function, and display the maximum value by default in the store.
14. The pet unlocking conditions have been obtained by the player. When unlocking the pet, a special mark is added to the unlocking props.
15.Fixed the issue that the Evolution Key did not use the three-color ore.

notes.title: Small Update V1.0.7
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the efficiency of the planting robot
2. Optimize the description of the management function help interface.
3. Optimize the planting robot function and add a one-click function to add all seeds
4. Optimize the operation of adding materials in the machine interface: support right-click to add all materials.
5. Fix the problem that the "Cooking Master" achievement is not unlocked.
6. Fix the text description of some props.
7. Fix the problem that the advanced speed gem prompt is not displayed correctly after unlocking the fragment.

notes.title: Small Update V1.0.6
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the problem that some functions did not refresh when switching languages in the game.
2. Fixed the problem that monsters had no target when the player returned to the safe area.
3. Fixed the problem that the task of fighting wolves in the Chamber of Commerce was refreshed at an early stage.
4. Tomato mushroom soup increased hunger recovery by 50 points.
5. "Hydraulic generator" was renamed "steam generator", and the construction materials of "steam generator" were modified.
6. Added the display of the Chamber of Commerce level experience bar.
7. The "shipping box" was renamed "stock box"
8. Added a shortcut key to open the backpack pet interface.
9. Added the function of displaying machine-related operation prompts on the right side of the screen in the machine operation interface.

notes.title: version update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the problem that the fog in the gene interface has a chance to display abnormally.
2. Corrected the Chinese wording in "Story".
3. Supplemented and corrected the sources of some props.
4. Fixed the problem that the name displayed incorrectly during NPC dialogues.
5. Corrected the description of some tasks.
6. Fixed the problem that when the robot transports goods to the transfer box, if the transfer box is full, the goods fall to the ground.
7. Optimized the priority processing of the transfer box.
8. Fixed the problem that the planting robot has a chance to plant seeds in the open space.
9. Removed Alena's trading function.
10. Added health bars to bosses in the game.
11. Corrected the location of cactus and gold mine collection.
12. Added the function of saving progress in bathing.
13. Fixed the problem that there is a chance that the door cannot be opened on the third floor of the copy.
14. Added building operation prompts in the help.
15. Added crab roe burger purchase in the tavern.

notes.title: Small Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:

3. Added a keybind to remove tilled but unplanted land.
4. Updated the land purchase quest prompt.
5. Fixed a bug with music and sound effects.
6. Fixed a bug where unlocking parts of the tech tree might not unlock the corresponding features.
